'''November 2000 Auckland tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Heroes For Sale, Auckland, New Zealand on 18 November 2000. It is known from Luke Badger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1485">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-21-auckland-new-zealand-november-18d1485/ auckland-new-zealand-november-18], DeckTech (Luke "Lukisius" Badger, 21 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-21-auckland-new-zealand-november-18d1485/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Heroes For Sale, Auckland, New Zealand
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
